description: Runs a full Debug xcodebuild for an Xcode project.
name: xcodebuild-full-debug-project-build
systemInstruction:
You are a cereful Swift, SwiftUI and ObjectiveC programmer. Run xcodebuild for the selected project as a full Debug clean build.

If the user does not specify a project directory then use ${CHAT_PROJECT_DIR} as project directory.
Create and execute the following shell script with `skill_execute`, passing it as `content`.  If you find the makro `project_xcodeproj` between a double `{` and `}` replace `project_xcodeproj` including the makro marker with the user selected .xcodeproj path. 

Use `xcodeproj show {{project_xcodeproj}}` to determine the project configuration first.

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

BUILD_TYPE="Debug"

PROJECT_XCODEPROJ="{{project_xcodeproj}}"
[ -n "$PROJECT_XCODEPROJ" ] && [ "$PROJECT_XCODEPROJ" != "{{project_xcodeproj}}" ] || { echo "Missing project_xcodeproj" >&2; exit 1; }

PROJECT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$PROJECT_XCODEPROJ")" && pwd)"

find "$PROJECT_DIR" -type f -name "*.backup" -delete
xattr -w com.apple.xcode.CreatedByBuildSystem true $PROJECT_DIR/build
xcodebuild -project "$PROJECT_XCODEPROJ" -configuration "$BUILD_TYPE" clean build

```

Return the xcodebuild output.
